{{Quote|Alliance High Command has authorized me to give you an experimental starship chassis. It is a heavy version of the X-wing fighter. It has much greater mass capacity than the standard one!|[[Rebel Outpost]]'s [[Station Master]]|<ref name="SWG:RotW" />}}
The '''advanced X-wing fighter''', also known as '''heavy X-wing starfighter''', was a heavy variant of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], developed as a result of the success of the [[Z-95-AF4-H multi-role starfighter|Heavy '95]].

==Description==
The Advanced X-wing was developed by engineers who, because of their allegiance to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], were forced to adopt a "develop more with less" policy, demonstrating the engineers' innovation. Likewise, because of this policy, the Rebel engineers often concentrated on making minute but consequential changes to their [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]].<ref name="SXw" />

The Advanced X-wing's development was owed largely to the success of the [[Z-95-AF4-H multi-role starfighter|Heavy '95]], a heavy variant of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], as the engineers realized that wider bodies were good improvements to various concerns of starship performance. In large part because of this, the Advanced X-wing was supplied with similar modifications to its hull as the Heavy '95 before finalizing the latter fighter design. The improved heat handling and increased mass capacity made the Advanced X-wing a better choice for X-wing pilots.<ref name="SXw" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several advanced X-wing starfighters were awarded to Rebel pilots for escorting and protecting representatives of the [[Civilian Protection Guild]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

As part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of advanced X-wings participated in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
